accounting_rules.cached_input_tokens: Already included in input_tokens; do not add twice
accounting_rules.reasoning_tokens: If exposed, already included in output_tokens; do not add twice
accounting_rules.preparation_status: Use not_applicable only when verified no preparation took place; set usage to 0 in that case
accounting_rules.end_to_end: Sum preparation and implementation totals only when both are known
accounting_rules.null_values: Unavailable / not yet measured; never replace with invented exact figures
accounting_rules.actual_api_cost: Use billed cost if accessible; do not label an estimate as actual
